name: Browse branded storefront and add product
description: Verifies the redesigned e-commerce storefront supports product discovery and cart entry.
expected: The branded storefront shows shop navigation, matching products are shown, and the selected product appears in the cart.

name: Open complete menu on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile menu exposes the store's main customer-facing destinations.
expected: The menu opens as an overlay and exposes Home, Shop All Products, Deals & Offers, Categories, How It Works, FAQ, Support, My Account, Cart & Checkout, and Admin.

name: Authenticated checkout submits manual payment verification
description: Verifies checkout requires sign-in and creates a pending-verification order after a transaction ID is submitted.
expected: The order is created as payment-verification-pending and is not delivered automatically.

name: Customer account and AI support
description: Verifies the authenticated account loads server-backed customer information and store support.
steps: Ask AI Support a product question
expected: Account information is shown and AI returns a store-related answer without financial or credential actions.

name: Admin authorization boundary
description: Verifies admin data remains protected while the configured administrator can access store counts.
steps: Sign in with the configured administrator
expected: Unauthenticated access does not expose admin data, while the configured administrator sees protected store counts.

name: Account sub-navigation
description: Verifies each customer account module has a distinct route and renders the relevant server-backed or state-backed section.
expected: Each module changes the account route and shows its dedicated content without collapsing every module into the same page.
